startupMetric: Process launch to first visible unowned top-level window (not first frame)
sampling: CPU window requested 30s with counter samples every ~5s; actual CPU/wall deltas retained; launch media position 0s, sampling begins after at least 10s media time and ten seconds settling. VLC media times are integer-quantized. Ordered variants rotate each round.
limitations: Warm OS caches; no cold-cache claim.
Window outer rectangles match; video viewport and default decoder may differ.
Samples cover owned root process only; inspect unexpected child processes separately.
Playback status does not prove pixels are visible or decoder hardware equivalence.
Child environment redirects ordinary profile/temp writes; Windows Known Folder APIs may bypass environment variables (VLC additionally uses portable/).
VLC RC verification adds a control-interface overhead.
MPC-HC uses a hidden /slave window to verify position; no decoder equivalence claim.
